checks.name: Mouse left, right and middle drags map to steering, roll and insertion
Touch one finger steers in both axes and every selected mode works
Two-finger translation, pinch and twist combine in a single checked pose request
Adding/removing fingers rebases without jumping; remaining finger continues
Third finger neither moves the pair nor resets its baseline
Wheel combines with ongoing drag instead of replacing its queue
Cancellation discards all pending travel; release drains it
Reversal after contact preserves all newly reversed axes
Handle grip reverses steering across the portal fulcrum
Twist crosses the ±180 degree boundary by the short angular change
Near-overlapping fingers cannot cause an unstable lens flip
Rigid camera coupling starts upright, rolls continuously and preserves lens position
Steering remains screen-relative with a rotated camera

scope: Production gesture-controller and camera-basis contracts. Native browser and collision-worker checks recorded separately.
